items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders after calf GTD/optimism.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; McVay optimistic, no setbacks.
items.implication: Full or near-full workload expected as WR1.
items.opportunity: High target share with Adams out longer-term.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive (quad); unlikely earlier, now confirmed.
items.why: Limited practice, not full participant after missing 3 games.
items.opportunity: Lead role for Jets RB2 (Braelon Allen unlisted).

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7.
items.why: ETR weekend summary; ankle injury, missed prior games.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB; elevated targets/carries for skill players.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share for Flowers, Henry, Andrews, Likely.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT.
items.implication: Eagles pass game funnels elsewhere with Saquon expected.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Goedert, other WRs; more RB involvement.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on slide; would have been tilting if injured avoiding score.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no major concern indicated.
items.implication: No major downgrade expected ROS/next week.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; watching post-game.
items.why: Turned ankle sliding to avoid TD.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; Levitan nearly certain fine.

items.text: Watching post-game: Waddle shoulder, Skattebo/Tracy hamstring, Gainwell hip (returned), others.
items.implication: Status for Week 8 TBD; Gainwell returned.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected/resumed lead RB role for Giants; finished 124 yards on 17 carries + TD.
items.why: Sources pregame; delivered production vs HOU.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share ROS if healthy (hamstring watch).

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to locker room (quad) then returned to game.
All ETR projections updated to latest news (Lamar/Puka/Breece etc crucial).
items.implication: Use for DFS/start-sit; matches ETR summary.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (Q) for MNF vs DAL after hamstring.
items.why: Full practice Saturday; trending right after missing games.
items.implication: Likely lead back if active; monitor final status.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected/IN to play.
Loves Saquon if active (RB15 rank); efficient prior, volume expected.
items.why: In line to play; efficient in games played.
items.implication: Must-start if active amid WR outs.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10 range) vs CHI.
items.why: Usage and favorable matchup; Bears allow yardage.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft TE buffet vs DET (TE6); Lions allow TE TDs/points.
items.why: DET vulnerable to TEs (9 TDs allowed recently).

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (shadow by Gonzalez); most targets outside.
items.why: 90% outside targets vs elite CB shadow; low floor recently.
items.conflict: Volume may still exist but efficiency down.

items.text: Hates Josh Downs in tough spot.
